_comment: Allowlist of repos the factory may open PRs on (and merge them, see autonomy): RepoHQ and the live products that have CI. Since 2026-10-12 it no longer maintains dormant personal repos (Open-Travel, family-tree and six others): in the 14 days before, 201 attempts produced 22 merges, mostly lint and docs, and a quarter hit the free models' rate limits. Add a live product once it has a CI workflow (codespend has none yet), since a repo without checks merges on the judge alone. Repos opened from RepoHQ's repo page (repositories.factory_enabled) come on top of this list.

autonomy._why: The owner's call (2026-10-12): the factory merges its own PRs once every check is green and nothing objected (smoke test, adversarial reviewer, a hold label, a review asking for changes), and reverts a merge whose commit turns the base branch red. He reviews it in the morning email. PRs touching protectedPaths (the factory's own code, CI workflows, the model router) stay with him. factory/lib/automerge.ts.
